objective: 将 RouteCodex v4 在独立 keeper worktree 中收敛到 AppSDK 0.1.6 治理面，并继续完成 Cordis 生产插件接线；保留业务源码、Protected、Active 与历史证据，不清理其他 worker 状态。
acceptance_criteria: AppSDK 0.1.6 official verify/compile path is used.
Request admission facts are emitted and consumed through typed NodePluginPlan control resource.
No local continuation, payload control leakage, fallback, or duplicate runtime path is introduced.
Keeper worktree remains isolated from main and other worker worktrees.
non_goals: Do not modify main, V3, other worktrees, or other worker claims.
Do not delete historical evidence, migration records, Protected, or Active artifacts.
Do not hand-write lifecycle hashes, ReviewRecord, EvidenceRecord, receipt, or Active projection.
